Linear equations & systems.prompt: A museum sold 52 tickets on Monday. Adult tickets cost $14 each and child tickets cost $9 each. If the museum collected $588 from these tickets, how many child tickets were sold?
Linear equations & systems.expl: x + y = 52 va 14x + 9y = 588. Birinchidan x = 52 − y; 14(52 − y) + 9y = 588 → 728 − 5y = 588 → y = 28. (24 — kattalar chiptalari soni, tuzoq.)

Linear equations & systems.prompt:
4x − 6y = 10
kx − 9y = 20

In the given system of equations, k is a constant. If the system has no solution, what is the value of k?
Linear equations & systems.expl: Yechim bo'lmasligi uchun chiziqlar parallel bo'lishi kerak: k/4 = −9/−6 = 3/2 → k = 6. Ozod hadlar nisbati 20/10 = 2 ≠ 3/2, demak chiziqlar ustma-ust tushmaydi.

Linear equations & systems.prompt:
3x + 5y = 7
12x + by = c

In the given system of equations, b and c are constants. If the system has infinitely many solutions, what is the value of b + c?
Linear equations & systems.expl: Cheksiz ko'p yechim — ikkinchi tenglama birinchisining 4 baravari: b = 20, c = 28. b + c = 48.

Linear equations & systems.prompt: The equation C = 45 + 0.18m gives the total cost C, in dollars, of renting a moving truck for one day and driving it m miles. What is the best interpretation of 0.18 in this context?
choices: The cost of renting the truck for one day without driving it
The additional cost, in dollars, for each mile the truck is driven
The total cost, in dollars, of driving the truck 18 miles
The number of miles the truck can be driven for $45
Linear equations & systems.expl: 0.18 — m ga ko'paytirilgan koeffitsient (qiyalik), ya'ni har bir mil uchun qo'shimcha narx. 45 — kunlik qat'iy to'lov.

Linear equations & systems.prompt: Dilnoza has $120 saved and plans to save $35 each week. What is the minimum number of whole weeks she must save so that her total savings are at least $1,000?
Linear equations & systems.expl: 120 + 35w ≥ 1000 → 35w ≥ 880 → w ≥ 25.14. Butun hafta kerak, shuning uchun 26.

Linear equations & systems.prompt: A line in the xy-plane passes through the points (2, 11) and (6, 3). At what point does the line cross the x-axis?
The formula P = 2ℓ + 2w gives the perimeter P of a rectangle with length ℓ and width w. Which of the following correctly expresses w in terms of P and ℓ?
Linear equations & systems.expl: 2w = P − 2ℓ → w = (P − 2ℓ)/2. 'P/2 − 2ℓ' — keng tarqalgan xato (faqat bitta hadni 2 ga bo'lish).

Linear equations & systems.prompt: Two pumps fill a tank. Pump A pumps 40 liters per minute and pump B pumps 25 liters per minute. On one day, pump A ran 6 minutes longer than pump B, and together they pumped 1,150 liters. For how many minutes did pump A run?
Linear equations & systems.expl: B t daqiqa ishlasa, A t + 6 daqiqa: 40(t + 6) + 25t = 1150 → 65t = 910 → t = 14. Savol A haqida: 14 + 6 = 20. (14 — tuzoq.)

Linear equations & systems.prompt:
(2/3)(x − 6) = (1/4)(x + 12)

What value of x satisfies the given equation?

The table shows values of the linear function f.

  x — f(x)
  −2 — 13
  1 — 4
  4 — −5

Which equation defines f?
Line k is defined by 5x − 2y = 8. Line j is perpendicular to line k and passes through the point (10, −1). What is the y-intercept of line j?
Linear equations & systems.expl: k: y = (5/2)x − 4, qiyalik 5/2. Perpendikulyar qiyalik −2/5. y + 1 = −2/5(x − 10) → y = −2/5 x + 3.

Linear equations & systems.prompt:
3x + 2y = 19
x − 2y = −3

If (x, y) is the solution to the given system of equations, what is the value of x + y?
How many solutions does the equation 4(3x − 5) − 2x = 10x − 20 have?
Linear equations & systems.expl: Chap tomon: 12x − 20 − 2x = 10x − 20, o'ng tomon bilan bir xil. Har qanday x yechim — cheksiz ko'p.

Linear equations & systems.prompt: Phone plan A costs $30 per month plus $0.10 per minute of calls. Plan B costs $18 per month plus $0.25 per minute. For how many minutes of calls in a month do the two plans cost the same amount?

y = 3x − 7
y = ax + 9

In the given system, a is a constant. If the solution to the system has an x-coordinate of 4, what is the value of a?
Linear equations & systems.expl: x = 4 bo'lsa, birinchi tenglamadan y = 3(4) − 7 = 5. Ikkinchisiga qo'yamiz: 5 = 4a + 9 → a = −1.

Linear equations & systems.prompt:
y ≤ −2x + 8
y > x − 1

Which of the following points (x, y) is a solution to the given system of inequalities?

A candle is 30 centimeters tall when it is lit. It burns at a constant rate, and after 4 hours it is 21 centimeters tall. Which equation gives the height h, in centimeters, of the candle t hours after it is lit?
Linear equations & systems.expl: Har soatda (30 − 21)/4 = 2.25 sm kamayadi. Boshlang'ich balandlik 30.

Linear equations & systems.prompt: In the xy-plane, a line with slope 2 passes through the points (k, 7) and (3, k), where k is a constant. What is the value of k?

Nonlinear functions.prompt: The function h(t) = −16(t − 2)² + 70 gives the height, in feet, of a ball t seconds after it is thrown. What is the maximum height, in feet, of the ball?
Nonlinear functions.expl: Cho'qqi shakli a(t − h)² + k: maksimum k = 70 bo'ladi (t = 2 da).

Nonlinear functions.prompt: What is the sum of the solutions to the equation 2x² − 10x − 28 = 0?

x² + kx + 49 = 0

In the given equation, k is a positive constant. If the equation has exactly one real solution, what is the value of k?
Nonlinear functions.expl: Bitta yechim — diskriminant 0: k² − 4(49) = 0 → k² = 196 → k = 14 (musbat).

Nonlinear functions.prompt: A town's population P can be modeled by P(t) = 8,400(1.035)ᵗ, where t is the number of years since 2015. Which of the following is the best interpretation of 1.035 in this context?
choices: The population increases by 3.5% each year.
The population increases by 35% each year.
The population increases by 1.035 people each year.

Nonlinear functions.prompt: The value of a machine decreases by half every 6 years. Its value was $24,000 when it was new. Which expression gives its value, in dollars, t years after it was new?
Nonlinear functions.expl: Har 6 yilda yarimga: t yilda t/6 marta yarimlanadi → 24,000(1/2)^(t/6).

Nonlinear functions.prompt: Which of the following is equivalent to 9x² − 25y²?
Nonlinear functions.expl: Kvadratlar ayirmasi: a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b), bu yerda a = 3x, b = 5y.

Nonlinear functions.prompt: The function f is defined by f(x) = x² − 4x + 1. The graph of y = g(x) is the graph of y = f(x) shifted 3 units to the right. Which equation defines g?

x/(x − 3) + 2 = 3/(x − 3)

How many solutions does the given equation have?
Nonlinear functions.expl: (x − 3) ga ko'paytiramiz: x + 2(x − 3) = 3 → 3x = 9 → x = 3. Lekin x = 3 da maxraj 0 bo'ladi — begona ildiz. Demak yechim yo'q.

Nonlinear functions.prompt:
√(2x + 7) = x − 4

What is the solution to the given equation?
Nonlinear functions.expl: Kvadratga oshiramiz: 2x + 7 = x² − 8x + 16 → x² − 10x + 9 = 0 → x = 9 yoki x = 1. x = 1 da o'ng tomon −3 (manfiy) — begona ildiz. Javob 9.

Nonlinear functions.prompt:
p(x) = x³ + ax² − 5x + 6

In the given polynomial, a is a constant. If x − 2 is a factor of p(x), what is the value of a?
Which expression is equivalent to (x⁶y⁻²)^(1/2) · x⁻¹y³, where x > 0 and y > 0?
A rectangular garden has a length that is 5 meters greater than its width. The area of the garden is 84 square meters. What is the width, in meters, of the garden?
For the function f, f(x) = a·bˣ, where a and b are positive constants. If f(1) = 12 and f(3) = 108, what is the value of f(0)?
The graph of y = (x − 5)(x + 3) in the xy-plane is a parabola. What is the x-coordinate of the vertex of the parabola?

y = x² − 6x + 13
y = 2x + c

In the given system, c is a constant. If the system has exactly one real solution, what is the value of c?
Nonlinear functions.expl: Tenglaymiz: x² − 8x + 13 − c = 0. Bitta yechim → diskriminant 0: 64 − 4(13 − c) = 0 → 13 − c = 16 → c = −3.

Nonlinear functions.prompt: An investment of $5,000 earns interest compounded annually at a rate of r percent. After 2 years, the investment is worth $5,618. What is the value of r?
Which expression is equivalent to (x² − 9)/(x² + x − 6), for x ≠ −3 and x ≠ 2?
The function g is defined by g(x) = 3x² − 2x. What is the value of g(−4)?

Ratios, rates, data.prompt: The price of a jacket was increased by 20%. Later, the new price was decreased by 20%. The final price is what percent of the original price?
A car travels at a constant speed of 72 kilometers per hour. How many meters does the car travel in 1 second?
The mean score of 8 students on a quiz was 76. When a ninth student's score was added, the mean of all 9 scores became 78. What was the ninth student's score?
A data set consists of 9 positive integers with a mean of 20 and a median of 18. If the largest value in the data set is increased by 45, which statement must be true?
choices: The mean increases by 5, and the median stays the same.
The mean and the median both increase by 5.
The mean increases by 45, and the median stays the same.
The mean stays the same, and the median increases.
Ratios, rates, data.expl: Yig'indi 45 ga oshadi → o'rtacha 45/9 = 5 ga oshadi. Eng katta qiymat o'zgarsa, o'rtadagi (5-) qiymat o'zgarmaydi — median bir xil.

Ratios, rates, data.prompt:
The table summarizes a survey of 70 students about their preferred club.

  Grade — Robotics — Debate — Total
  10th — 18 — 12 — 30
  11th — 14 — 26 — 40
  Total — 32 — 38 — 70

If a student who prefers debate is selected at random, what is the probability that the student is in 11th grade?
Ratios, rates, data.expl: Shart: debatni tanlagan 38 o'quvchi ichidan. Ulardan 11-sinf — 26. Ehtimollik 26/38. (26/40 — tuzoq: maxraj noto'g'ri tanlangan.)

Ratios, rates, data.prompt: A printer can print 150 pages in 6 minutes. A second printer can print the same 150 pages in 10 minutes. Working together at these rates, how many minutes will it take the two printers to print 600 pages?
Ratios, rates, data.expl: Tezliklar: 25 va 15 bet/daqiqa, birga 40 bet/daqiqa. 600/40 = 15 daqiqa.

Ratios, rates, data.prompt: A researcher randomly selected 200 adults from a city of 90,000 adults and found that 46 of them cycle to work. Based on this sample, which is the best estimate of the number of adults in the city who cycle to work?
Based on a random sample, a survey estimates that 62% of a town's residents support a new park, with a margin of error of 4%. Which conclusion is most appropriate?
choices: It is plausible that between 58% and 66% of all residents support the park.
Exactly 62% of all residents support the park.
Between 58% and 66% of the residents in the sample support the park.
At least 66% of all residents support the park.
Ratios, rates, data.expl: Xato chegarasi butun aholi haqidagi ehtimoliy oraliqni beradi: 62 ± 4 → 58%–66%. Tanlovning o'zida esa aniq 62%.

Ratios, rates, data.prompt: The ratio of red marbles to blue marbles in a bag is 3 to 5. After 18 red marbles are added, the ratio of red marbles to blue marbles becomes 3 to 2. How many blue marbles are in the bag?
After a 15% increase, the number of members in a club is 69. How many members did the club have before the increase?
For a group of apartments, the line of best fit for monthly rent r, in dollars, and floor area a, in square meters, is r = 14.5a + 230. Which statement is the best interpretation of 14.5?
choices: For each additional square meter of floor area, the predicted monthly rent increases by about $14.50.
Every apartment in the group costs $14.50 per square meter per month.
An apartment with 0 square meters is predicted to cost $14.50.
The predicted floor area increases by 14.5 square meters for each additional dollar of rent.
Ratios, rates, data.expl: Qiyalik — har bir qo'shimcha kvadrat metr uchun bashorat qilingan ijaraning o'zgarishi. 'Har bir kvartira' — haddan oshirilgan da'vo: bu faqat model.

Ratios, rates, data.prompt: In 2020, 40% of a school's graduates enrolled in a university. In 2024, 50% did. Which statement is accurate?
choices: The enrollment rate increased by 10 percentage points, which is a 25% increase.
The enrollment rate increased by 10%, which is 10 percentage points.
The enrollment rate increased by 25 percentage points.
The number of graduates who enrolled increased by 25%.
Ratios, rates, data.expl: 50 − 40 = 10 foiz punkt; nisbiy o'sish 10/40 = 25%. Bitiruvchilar soni noma'lum, shuning uchun son haqida xulosa qilib bo'lmaydi.

Ratios, rates, data.prompt: On a map, 2 centimeters represent 15 kilometers. Two towns are 9 centimeters apart on the map. What is the actual distance, in kilometers, between the towns?

In a study of 400 patients, 240 received a new treatment and the rest received a standard treatment. Of those who received the new treatment, 180 recovered. Of those who received the standard treatment, 104 recovered. Which statement is supported by these data?
choices: The recovery rate was 75% for the new treatment and 65% for the standard treatment.
The recovery rate was 75% for the new treatment and 104% for the standard treatment.
More patients recovered with the standard treatment than with the new treatment.
The recovery rate was 45% for the new treatment and 26% for the standard treatment.
Ratios, rates, data.expl: Yangi: 180/240 = 75%. Standart: 400 − 240 = 160 bemor, 104/160 = 65%. 45% va 26% — umumiy 400 ga bo'lingan (tuzoq).

Ratios, rates, data.prompt:
Data set A: 10, 20, 30, 40, 50
Data set B: 28, 29, 30, 31, 32

Which statement about the two data sets is true?
choices: The means are equal, and the standard deviation of A is greater.
The means are equal, and the standard deviation of B is greater.
The mean of A is greater, and the standard deviations are equal.
The means and the standard deviations are both equal.
Ratios, rates, data.expl: Ikkala o'rtacha ham 30. A qiymatlari o'rtachadan ancha uzoq tarqalgan — standart og'ish A da kattaroq.

Ratios, rates, data.prompt: A cyclist rode 24 kilometers to a lake at an average speed of 24 kilometers per hour and returned along the same route at an average speed of 12 kilometers per hour. What was the cyclist's average speed, in kilometers per hour, for the entire round trip?
Ratios, rates, data.expl: Vaqt: 24/24 = 1 soat va 24/12 = 2 soat, jami 3 soat. O'rtacha tezlik 48/3 = 16. (18 — tuzoq: tezliklarning oddiy o'rtachasi.)

Lines, angles, circles.prompt:
x² + y² − 6x + 8y = 11

The equation of a circle in the xy-plane is given. What is the radius of the circle?
Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF, where A corresponds to D and B corresponds to E. If AB = 12, DE = 18, and BC = 10, what is the length of EF?
In right triangle PQR, angle Q is the right angle and sin(P) = 0.6. What is the value of cos(R)?
Lines, angles, circles.expl: To'g'ri burchakli uchburchakda P va R to'ldiruvchi burchaklar: cos(R) = sin(P) = 0.6.

Lines, angles, circles.prompt: A circle has a radius of 9 centimeters. An arc of the circle is intercepted by a central angle of 2π/3 radians. What is the length, in centimeters, of the arc?

A cylindrical tank has a radius of 3 meters and a height of 8 meters. Water is poured into the tank at a rate of 2π cubic meters per minute. How many minutes will it take to fill the tank completely, if the tank starts empty?

Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. One of the angles formed measures (3x + 10)°, and the angle on the same side of the transversal between the parallel lines (a same-side interior angle) measures (5x + 10)°. What is the value of x?
Lines, angles, circles.expl: Bir tomondagi ichki burchaklar yig'indisi 180°: 8x + 20 = 180 → x = 20.

Lines, angles, circles.prompt: In a 30°-60°-90° triangle, the side opposite the 30° angle has length 7. What is the length of the hypotenuse?
A circle has a radius of 10 inches. What is the area, in square inches, of a sector with a central angle of 72°? (Express your answer in terms of π by entering only the coefficient of π.)
A circle in the xy-plane has center (−2, 5) and passes through the point (4, −3). Which equation defines the circle?
Each dimension of a rectangular prism is multiplied by 3. The volume of the new prism is how many times the volume of the original prism?
In triangle XYZ, the measure of angle X is 48°, and the exterior angle at vertex Z measures 115°. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle Y?
Lines, angles, circles.expl: Tashqi burchak ikki qo'shni bo'lmagan ichki burchaklar yig'indisiga teng: 115 = 48 + Y → Y = 67.

Lines, angles, circles.prompt: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle, AC = 20, and BC = 21. What is the value of tan(A)?
Points A, B, and C lie on a circle with center O. The measure of central angle AOB is 110°. Point C lies on the major arc AB. What is the measure of inscribed angle ACB?
Lines, angles, circles.expl: Ichki chizilgan burchak bir xil yoyga tiralgan markaziy burchakning yarmi: 110/2 = 55°.

Lines, angles, circles.prompt: An angle measures 3π/8 radians. What is the measure of the angle in degrees?
A square has side length 10. A circle is inscribed in the square, touching all four sides. The area of the region inside the square but outside the circle is 100 − kπ. What is the value of k?
Lines, angles, circles.expl: Doira radiusi 5, yuzi 25π. Qolgan yuz 100 − 25π → k = 25.

Lines, angles, circles.prompt: In triangle ABC, point D lies on AB and point E lies on AC such that DE is parallel to BC. If AD = 6, DB = 9, and DE = 8, what is the length of BC?
Lines, angles, circles.expl: ADE va ABC o'xshash: AB = 15, nisbat 15/6 = 2.5. BC = 8 × 2.5 = 20.
